statement: Let M = 1000000007. A length-5 index subsequence is a tuple (p0,p1,p2,p3,p4) with 0 <= p0 < p1 < p2 < p3 < p4 < len(nums). For such a tuple let a_j = nums[p_j] for j=0..4, and for every integer value v let count(v) be the number of j in {0,1,2,3,4} with a_j = v. Call the tuple good when count(v) < count(a2) for every integer v with v != a2; equivalently, the third selected value a2 is the unique value of maximum frequency among the five selected values. Let N be the number of good tuples. Then the function returns a result r and r = N mod M, where 0 <= r < M.
preconditions: len(nums) is between 5 and 1000 inclusive, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r on an input satisfying the preconditions, 0 <= r <= 1000000006.
preconditions: len(nums) is between 5 and 1000 inclusive, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: For every input satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result r and does not fail: no arithmetic overflow, no out-of-bounds access, and no panic occurs.
preconditions: len(nums) is between 5 and 1000 inclusive, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Let f0 be the number of occurrences of nums[2] among the five entries nums[0], nums[1], nums[2], nums[3], nums[4], and for each value v different from nums[2] let f(v) be the number of occurrences of v among those five entries. The function returns r = 1 if f0 > f(v) for every v != nums[2], and returns r = 0 otherwise.
preconditions: len(nums) = 5 and each nums[i] is between -1000000000 and 1000000000 inclusive.

statement: The function returns r = (len(nums) choose 5) mod 1000000007.
preconditions: 5 <= len(nums) <= 1000 and there is an integer c such that nums[i] = c for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), with c between -1000000000 and 1000000000.
5 <= len(nums) <= 1000, each nums[i] is between -1000000000 and 1000000000, and nums[i] != nums[j] for all i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums).

statement: Let N be the number of length-5 index subsequences whose third selected value is the unique mode among the five selected values. Whenever the function returns a nonzero result r (r != 0), N > 0; equivalently, there exist indices 0 <= p0 < p1 < p2 < p3 < p4 < len(nums) such that nums[p2] is the unique mode among nums[p0], nums[p1], nums[p2], nums[p3], nums[p4].
preconditions: len(nums) is between 5 and 1000 inclusive, and every nums[i] is between -1000000000 and 1000000000.

statement: The result returned for nums equals the result returned for rev.
preconditions: nums and its reversal rev both have length between 5 and 1000 inclusive and all their entries are between -1000000000 and 1000000000, where rev[i] = nums[len(nums)-1-i].

statement: The result returned for nums equals the result returned for nums2.
preconditions: nums and nums2 are two slices with the same length n, where 5 <= n <= 1000, all entries of both slices are between -1000000000 and 1000000000, and for all i,j with 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n, nums[i] = nums[j] if and only if nums2[i] = nums2[j].

statement: Let N be the number of length-5 index subsequences for which the third selected value is the unique mode among the five selected values. Then the function returns r = N.
preconditions: 5 <= len(nums) <= 100 and all entries are between -1000000000 and 1000000000.

statement: Let N be the number of length-5 index subsequences whose third selected value is the unique mode among the five selected values. Whenever the function returns a result r, r - N is divisible by 1000000007.
preconditions: len(nums) is between 5 and 1000 inclusive, and every nums[i] is between -1000000000 and 1000000000.

statement: If there is no index tuple 0 <= p0 < p1 < p2 < p3 < p4 < len(nums) for which nums[p2] is the unique mode among nums[p0], nums[p1], nums[p2], nums[p3], nums[p4], then the function returns r = 0.
preconditions: len(nums) is between 5 and 1000 inclusive, and every nums[i] is between -1000000000 and 1000000000.
